# Agent Python Tools

## File: facebookresearch_habitat-lab/habitat-lab/habitat/articulated_agents/humanoids/kinematic_humanoid.py

Prompts

```
['create a KinematicHumanoid agent with agent config, simulator, and optional joint limits or fixed base', 'set the humanoid joint positions, offset transform, and base transform using set_joint_transform', 'get the current joint positions and base transformation of the humanoid via get_joint_transform', 'set the humanoid agent back to its resting pose using set_rest_position', 'reconfigure the humanoid by loading URDF, setting kinematic motion type, and removing joint motors']
```

Usage

```
{'create_KinematicHumanoid': 'create a KinematicHumanoid agent with agent config, simulator, and optional joint limits or fixed base', 'set_joint_transform': 'set the humanoid joint positions, offset transform, and base transform using set_joint_transform', 'get_joint_transform': 'get the current joint positions and base transformation of the humanoid via get_joint_transform', 'set_rest_position': 'set the humanoid agent back to its resting pose using set_rest_position', 'reconfigure_KinematicHumanoid': 'reconfigure the humanoid by loading URDF, setting kinematic motion type, and removing joint motors'}
```
